symbols.read: Price has pushed further to 749.85, extending the grind toward the 758.57 pivot and keeping the bearish breakdown stalled, though the 4H stays bearish and the combined signal has flipped from SELL to HOLD, softening conviction. The 758.57 short is still MISSED, so 758.57 stays the invalidation line with hard stop 775.89 and target 721.33. Bias stays bearish but is now weaker than the previous read given the 1H flip and the combined HOLD, while the BULLISH regime tag still conflicts with the bearish structure. Invalidation is unchanged: a reclaim of 758.57.

Bias unchanged from the prior read — constructive above the FVG, capped below 2,527.57.
